title: Lakewatch streaming detection rules (Experimental)
body: Lakewatch now supports streaming detection rules, which evaluate each new row of a source table as it arrives and create a signal for every row that matches a SQL predicate. Use them for low-latency signature, indicator of compromise (IOC), and atomic-signal detections. Lakewatch manages the compute, so you don't select a SQL warehouse or a schedule. Streaming rules are an experimental feature. See [Streaming detection rules](/aws/en/lakewatch/detections/streaming-detection-rules).
